saw_lines: Waffle iron buyers picture one specific breakfast, then check whether the plates clean easily and the unit fits the counter.
So the sale is decided in the first line, and yours opens on the device, not the breakfast.
Your site shows 2171 reviews, yet 0 of 6 ads carry that number, so buyers get no proof. Put it on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
ads_1: Breakfast-led video ads with a review quote, tested against the device opener
